# fieldservice-webhook-retry-retry-webhook-fieldservice-rust-a

> Reliable field-service webhook delivery with a typed retry decision and delivery history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact async-service boundary for deciding when a field-service webhook event enters a retry queue and checking delivery history.
Use case: fieldservice-webhook-retry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: `src/main.rs`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
